summary: The recorded base reproduced the serial CFG timestep-0 double reset and CFG-parallel negative-rank cross-request leak. The exact candidate fixes both lifecycle failures and topology-aware skip-boundary accounting in focused and independent tests.

tests.what_was_measured: On base, serial negative timestep-0 reset cnt from 1 to 0; a later negative-only request retained cnt=50, both stale negative tensors, and accumulator=7.0.
Exact candidate regression and existing sampling parameter coverage: 46 passed, 23 subtests passed.
One reset per serial request; independent positive/negative CFG-parallel resets; stale GPU cache clearing; no noninitial reset; non-CFG topology; serial versus parallel boundary scaling.
No whitespace errors in the candidate diff.

gpu_execution.evidence: One AMD Instinct MI350X/gfx950 was used for GPU-resident stale TeaCache tensors and an independent numerical tensor check; ROCm 7.2, torch 2.11.0+rocm7.2.

remaining_limitations: No Wan model weights were available; no full diffusion generation or image-quality/semantic validation was performed.
Only one assigned GPU was available; no live multi-rank CFG-parallel workload was run.
No native source changed, so native rebuild validation was not applicable.
Standalone direct callers must initialize or patch global server arguments; production server startup does so.
